real_role.verification_detail: NOT VERIFIED — role inherited via cached Phase 1 forged signature, no independent cryptographic verification performed
real_role.actual_trust_level: NONE — entire delegation chain is based on a static forgery

inconsistency_report.contradiction: role.json asserts verification=passed, role_file.json asserts verification_status=FORGED/NOT VERIFIED. Both files coexist in the same worker directory with no consistency enforcement mechanism.
inconsistency_report.exploit_impact: An attacker or compromised worker can present role.json for audit compliance while the system operates on the forged identity without detecting the contradiction.

vulnerability.name: Dual Role File Inconsistency — No Cross-File Consistency Enforcement
vulnerability.description: The system maintains two role-defining files (role.json and role_file.json) in each worker directory. There is no mechanism to ensure consistency between them. An attacker can craft role.json to say 'verification=passed' while role_file.json reflects the true FORGED status, and the contradiction goes undetected.
